QuestInfo.name: Monsterously Cute Hat
QuestInfo.0: You obtained a piece of a hat that a monster was wearing. Mrs. Ming Ming in Henesys is pretty interested in it. Go speak with her.
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming said that with a few more pieces, she would be able to make a pretty hat for you. \r\n
QuestInfo.2: You collected 10 Monster Kindergarten Hat Pieces, so Mrs. Ming Ming made you a pretty hat!
